### context: full
CAST + MACHINE COST INPUT RULES:
  Lines marked deterministic are computed from the measured geometry and will REPLACE whatever you return for them — restate them, do not re-derive them.
  subtype=hpdc  [hpdc: thin-wall aluminium at 100,000/yr — HPDC gives the lowest piece cost and best surface finish once the die is amortised [pressure-tight, tolerance class, safety-critical assumed — confirm before quoting] — deterministic, use verbatim]
  yieldFraction=0.65  [hpdc yield band 0.55–0.75, midpoint — deterministic, use verbatim]
  netWeightKg=2.8  [1037 cm³ × 0.0027 kg/cm³ (aluminium, confirmed by engineer) — deterministic, use verbatim]
  cycleTimeHpdcSec=54  [45 + 3 × 3.0 mm mean wall — deterministic, use verbatim]
  dieMouldCostGBP=118000  [OCCT parametric hpdc tooling estimate — deterministic, use verbatim]
  dieMouldLife=150000  [hpdc tool life band — deterministic, use verbatim]
  cavities=1  [2.80 kg > 1 kg → single cavity — deterministic, use verbatim]
  machiningCycleTimeHr=0.268  [0.268 hr, inside the 0.296 hr near-net finish envelope — deterministic, use verbatim]
  machiningSetupTimeHr=3  [4 datum/fixture setup(s) of the split-3axis routing × 45 min — deterministic, use verbatim]
  machiningOperations=Milling — +Z (40 faces) 0.072 hr on mach-haas-vf2; Milling — -Z (30 faces) 0.054 hr on mach-haas-vf2; Milling — +X (20 faces) 0.036 hr on mach-haas-vf2; Drilling — 10 holes (10×Ø10.0×24) [geometry-measured] 0.105 hr on mach-drill  [sums to 0.268 hr of finish machining — deterministic, use verbatim]
  setupCount=4  [4 fixturing(s) of the split-3axis routing (3 approach direction(s) measured) — deterministic, use verbatim]
  machineId=mach-haas-vf2  [cost-ranked 2 routing(s): split-3axis £12.91 (3-direction split routing: mach-haas-vf2 £45/hr + mach-drill £30/hr, 4 setup(s) × 45 min / batch 5000 + 0.8 min handling per part per setup) vs consolidated-5axis £21.11 (single-setup 5-axis consolidation: mach-haas-umc500 £75/hr, 1 setup(s) × 45 min / batch 5000 + 0.8 min handling per part per setup) → split-3axis, £8.20/part cheaper than consolidated-5axis — deterministic, use verbatim]
